positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
	Worked as a project manager + technical management  for Node.js based software platform development project for Samsung mobile and TV device
	When I joined this project, it was in the initial stage for project setup and requirement analysis. As a project manger, I discussed with customer(Samsung internal division) to understand their need and suggested them projects. A project for Samsung smart TV with Node.JS is setup successfully and funded by the division. I was also drived technical meetings to design the software architecture for the project.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
     Project for launching mobile messenger application for global(30 countries+) and 6 different platforms(iOS, Android, Web, Java, Bada, Blackberry)
	Developed Android messenger application
	Successfully launched in more than 30 countries
        Lead Android software development team (10 software engineer)
     Managed outsourced application development (5 different OS)

positions.title: Lab head
positions.description:
Directed a lab of around 40 engineers dedicated to user experience (UX) related software development (usability evaluation/analysis, new UX concept prototyping, UX solution outsourcing and integration, and performance optimization)
	Analyzed UX usability for the Galaxy-S (the first model of Galaxy series), and significantly improved the usability, gained positive feedback from market which provided a turning point for the Samsung smartphone business
	Enhanced UX graphic performance through home screen application optimization and open GL-ES, gained positive feedback from market for performance enhancement in Galaxy-S and Bada phones
